name: Vector foundry / a line can hold a world
art: This is an original native SVG projection. Read the shared surface equation and point projection rather than replacing the drawing with a static image.

properties.label: Serif editorial sheet with wave specimen
properties.text: Balance a large narrow serif statement with an isometric ruled wave sheet on a paper-and-blueprint surface. Frame it with a fine ground projection, specimen index, measured-looking annotation and small seal.

properties.label: One equation for contour and ruling
properties.text: Construct the wave from crisp continuous vector paths in a carefully proportioned 2:1-like isometric projection. The outer contour and internal rulings must derive from the same parametric surface; detail is structural rather than textured 3D decoration.

properties.label: Warm paper and blue-green line ranks
properties.text: Use warm paper with muted blue-green line ranks, one restrained accent and enough contrast to separate contour, ruling, ground and annotation.

properties.label: Flat, Ripple and Surge amplitude control
properties.text: Flat, Ripple and Surge select wave character; a continuous height control changes amplitude. Native SVG paths derive from one surface without requiring a 3D library. One phase drives motion and stops when hidden or reduced.

properties.label: Projected path integrity
properties.text: Inspect outline and ruling at maximum amplitude, motion extremes and portrait reflow. Reject broken joins, differing projections and unnecessary full SVG remounts each frame. Keep dimension-like annotations truthful to the illustration's role.
